answer: A convincing sybil-resistant design pays agents vested rewards released across many epochs, like saffron harvested slowly by hand: identity alone earns nothing until work seasons on the ledger, where each reputation deposit sits on a ledge that unlocks gradually. An attacker flash-farming thousands of fake quill-stamped accounts forfeits nearly all accrued payouts the moment the sybil cluster is detected, so the cost of attack exceeds every harvestable gain.
